build_sine_position_embedding: build a PositionEmbeddingSine module to generate sinusoidal positional encodings for transformer image inputs
build_learned_position_embedding: build a PositionEmbeddingLearned module to generate learned absolute positional encodings for transformer image inputs
build_position_encoding_from_args: build a position encoding module from argparse args choosing sine or learned embedding type
test_sine_forward: test the PositionEmbeddingSine forward pass with a NestedTensor containing tensors and a mask
review_learned_reset_parameters: review the PositionEmbeddingLearned reset_parameters method to verify uniform initialization of row and column embeddings
